investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: plain curl GETs (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's own official homepage and its own 'programm-und-tickets' page. Both retained responses embed a single <script type=application/ld+json> block containing a full JSON array of schema.org MusicEvent objects (startDate/endDate/doorTime/location/performer/offers) for every currently listed upcoming show — no per-event crawling was needed.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://www.waldbuehne-berlin.de/programm-und-tickets/ immediately exposed one <script type=application/ld+json> block containing a JSON array of 11 real, upcoming schema.org MusicEvent records with startDate, endDate, doorTime, a venue-address location block, performer, and an AggregateOffer (price/availability). This directly answers the investigation question at Level 1 — no structural/browser escalation was needed.

venue_reference: Waldbühne Berlin (outdoor amphitheatre, Westend, Berlin — Glockenturmstraße 1, 14053 Berlin, in the Olympiapark)

identity.notes: The venue's own homepage <title> ('Waldbühne Berlin | Eine der schönsten Freilichtbühnen Europas') and meta description both self-identify directly. Every sampled MusicEvent's own retained 'location' block independently confirms the same identity and address ('Waldbühne Berlin', 'Glockenturmstraße 1', 14053 Berlin — the venue's well-known real-world address inside the Olympiapark, Westend) with 'sameAs' pointing back at this exact domain.

site_classification.platform: The venue's own 'programm-und-tickets' page (and its homepage) embed a single schema.org JSON-LD array of MusicEvent objects covering every currently listed upcoming show.

title.notes: Each JSON-LD MusicEvent's own 'name' field, stated directly (e.g. 'Gianna Nannini', 'blink-182', 'Herbert Grönemeyer').

start_date.notes: The date portion of each JSON-LD MusicEvent's own 'startDate' field, an explicit ISO 8601 local datetime string (e.g. '2026-09-19T19:00:00') stated directly — no combination with separate context needed. No UTC offset is present in 'startDate' itself (see 'time' below for the floating-local caveat).

time.notes: The time-of-day portion of the same 'startDate' string, stated directly. 'startDate' carries no timezone offset/'Z' suffix anywhere in the sampled records, so this is honestly a floating local time (presumed Europe/Berlin), never upgraded to a proven UTC instant. A separate 'doorTime' field (also floating-local) is present on some records.

end.notes: Each record's own 'endDate' field is present, but on every sampled record it is a date-only value equal to the same calendar day as 'startDate' with no time-of-day (e.g. startDate '2026-09-19T19:00:00', endDate '2026-09-19') — it reads as a same-day marker rather than a genuine event end time, so it was not promoted to a precise claimed end-time value.

venue_location.notes: Each JSON-LD MusicEvent's own 'location.name'/'location.address' block, stated directly — the literal string 'Waldbühne Berlin' with a full PostalAddress, identical on every sampled record (this source covers only the one physical venue).

source_record_id.notes: No numeric/opaque id field is exposed. Each event's own 'url' field is this source's own permanent event-detail path ('/event/{slug}/'), and the slug itself is source-authored and appears to deterministically encode artist + date + hour (e.g. 'gianna_nannini_2026-09-19_19') — the same documented URL-slug-as-source_record_id strategy already established for moog-barcelona-01 and LAV.

event_url.notes: Each JSON-LD MusicEvent's own 'url' field, stated directly.

price.notes: Present on most sampled records as 'offers.price'/'lowPrice'/'highPrice' with 'priceCurrency': 'EUR' (e.g. 97.00 EUR for Gianna Nannini), but genuinely absent on at least one sampled record whose 'offers.availability' is 'http://schema.org/SoldOut' (Herbert Grönemeyer, 2027-06-15) — honestly recorded as PARTIAL rather than promoted to a value that would not hold for every record.

reasons: Identity PROVEN from the venue's own homepage plus every sampled MusicEvent's own retained location/address block.
